defect_observations.observation: Held source printed p.145 reports the roulette approximation as P(chi >= 1) = 0.1587, obtained after replacing sigma by 1 (threshold 361(1/19)/19 = 1). The handbook calls 1 - Phi(19/sqrt(360)) ~ 0.1583 'the source approximation' and presents 0.1587 as the variant; the annex (lines 521-535) does not display the sigma = 1 threshold. Both values and the sigma = 1 variant are present, so this was not scored as a coverage failure, but the wording should name 0.1587 as the value the source reports.

The random-index theorem yields the normalizer sigma*sqrt(a_t) with a_t = floor(t/mu); the displayed limit uses sigma*sqrt(t/mu) without stating the a_t/(t/mu) -> 1 rescaling through the perturbation lemma.

The body's 'Equivalently (S_n - n mu)/sqrt(n) => sigma chi' rescaling for sigma > 0 is not argued in the annex; it is immediate from the CDF definition of => or the perturbation lemma with constant A_n = sigma.

E W^2 = v is introduced with 'Similarly', but the step is named (expand the square; cross terms vanish by the independence-and-centering reason given for W^4), and the identity is also thm:p15-independent-moments. Not scored as partial.

Several prerequisites in the CLT annex are invoked by description without a cross-reference: Polya transform (thm:p15-characteristic-inverse-examples), integrable inversion (thm:p15-characteristic-integrable-inversion), Riemann-Lebesgue (thm:p15-criteria-real-integration), continuity theorem (thm:p15-characteristic-continuity-theorem, used e.g. at lines 469, 895, 1252), Stirling (thm:p15-stirling-with-remainder, line 446), renewal inverse law (thm:p15-renewal-inverse-law, line 775), and the weak laws (lines 716, 726, 736). Each target exists on the route; readers get no pointer.

The CLT chapter body contains no index entries. The queue unit's lookup block records final_subject_task_cases_pending: true, so the unit-level lookup obligation is still open. It is not one of the listed components, so it was not scored here.
